spec_match.rationale: Each card calls the exact web API Chromium's ClientSideDetectionHost maps to a ClientSideDetectionType (csd.proto): requestFullscreen, keyboard.lock, requestPointerLock, vibrate, clipboard.writeText, Notification.requestPermission.

interactive.rationale: Six real API calls plus a chained fullscreen+keyboard.lock+pointer-lock lockdown sequence with automatic release; event log records fullscreenchange/pointerlockchange.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises real calls and the de-fanged lockdown sequence; both present.

edge_cases.rationale: Reports not-exposed APIs, rejected promises, keyboard.lock resolving outside fullscreen without effect, and notification prompt not shown when permission already decided.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, csd.proto, client_side_detection_host.cc, the Security Blog post and the three API specs.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite asserts every trigger surface plus the manual (blocked) server-verdict contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless google-chrome via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch: every control clicked, live readouts changed as expected, zero console errors / page errors / failed requests, no horizontal overflow; screenshots Read. Desktop: all six calls resolved, lockdown entered and released (fullscreenElement null afterwards).

telemetry_health.rationale: Per-trigger settled asserts with outcome details; lockdown asserts engaged or an explicit unavailable fallback id.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables; result text black on stone, emerald-dark/rose verdict words.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with visible names, outputs with aria-live, role=log event list, focus-visible outlines, exit button inside the fullscreen stage.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Layout verified at 360 and 1280; on mobile Keyboard/Pointer Lock may be absent and the cards say 'not exposed' rather than faking success (the feature itself is desktop-only).

openQuestions.title: Show Chrome's own 'press and hold Esc' hint evidence
openQuestions.detail: Headless cannot capture browser UI; capture the hint on a headed Chrome 155 to back the escape-hatch claim.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Only DOM/labels were checked via headless Playwright; chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable here (project rule 7b), so the a11y tree was not inspected.

openQuestions.title: No real Enhanced Safe Browsing run
openQuestions.detail: The server-side check itself cannot be triggered or observed from a page; nobody has confirmed end-to-end on an ESB-enabled Chrome 155 desktop profile that the documented triggers start an intelligent scan.

guidanceConsulted.query: keyboard lock fullscreen pointer lock user activation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native controls, visible focus, labelled controls, live status for changing state.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native buttons/inputs with labels, :focus-visible outlines, role=status/aria-live outputs and role=log event list.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright DOM checks; keyboard-reachable native controls.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two column tool layout mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets usable and content within its container on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grids use auto-fit minmax(min(100%, Nrem), 1fr); buttons min 44x44; wide content wraps or scrolls in labelled regions.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button accessible feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Copy via navigator.clipboard.writeText with try/catch, report success AND failure in a role=status bubble outside the button, clear after timeout, don't disable the button.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: status span outside the button, data-copied/data-failed outline (not colour only — text message), timer reset on repeat clicks. Invoker commands not used — exception: plain click handler keeps one code path for the demo's explicit writeText call.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright: 'Copied 91 chars' and clipboard.readText() returned the payload.
